name: Mövenpick Hotel Abidjan
desc: The Mövenpick Hotel Abidjan is a rare and delightfully authentic hotel in Abidjan's Plateau district, close to investment banks, ministries, embassies and the European Union delegation. We're just 8.5 miles from the airport, with a 25-minute transfer service, ideal if you're looking to mix business with the pleasure of exploring the friendly vibe of this lovely area
address: Avenue Terrasson De Fougeres, Angle Rue Gourgas Le Plateau, 01 BP 7335

name: Pullman Abidjan
desc: Located in the vibrant heart of Abidjan, the Pullman Abidjan welcomes you to a world where contemporary elegance meets the African lifestyle. Situated just a few steps from the Ébrié Lagoon, Le Plateau, and its business centers, the hotel is an ideal address for discovering the city amidst sophistication, culture, and entertainment.

name: Sofitel Abidjan Hotel Ivoire
desc: On the edge of Ébrié Lagoon in the Abidjan region, Sofitel Abidjan Hôtel Ivoire has 426 spacious and stylish rooms and suites with views of the lagoon or the chic Cocody district. The spa, gym, 3D cinema, outdoor pool, restaurants and bars invite you to relax. The hotel will assist you with professional and private events in the 16 modern, fully-equipped conference rooms and 1650-seat convention center.
address: Boulevard Hassan II, Cocody, 08 Bp 01 Abidjan

name: Aparthotel Adagio Abidjan Marcory
desc: Visiting Abidjan for business or leisure? Enjoy complete independence in one of our 110 self-contained 1- or 2-bedroom apartments, fully furnished with equipped kitchens. Access to Novotel Marcory's fitness center, outdoor swimming pool, meeting spaces, relaxation and dining areas. Aparthotel Adagio Abidjan Marcory is ideally located near the airport, business district, entertainment venues and stores.
address: Bd Félix Houphouët Boigny ex VGE

name: Novotel Abidjan Plateau
desc: The 4-star Novotel Abidjan Plateau hotel welcomes you for a unique experience on the edge of Ebrié lagoon, in the Plateau business district. Ideal for a business trip or relaxing weekend, it offers a paying shuttle service between the airport and the hotel. During your visit, explore the dynamic Plateau district and discover the superb beaches of Bassam and Assinie; perfect for an unforgettable getaway.
address: 10 Avenue du General de Gaulle, Plateau, 01 BP 3718

name: Ibis Styles Abidjan Plateau
desc: Recently renovated and in the heart of Abidjan's Plateau business district, ibis Styles Abidjan Plateau is a stylish hotel located near most of the administrative and economic institutions. This hotel with WOJO co-working spaces is ideal for business stays. Discover local and international flavors at the bar and restaurant. The team will share its top recommendations with you for a pleasant stay.

name: ibis Styles Abidjan Marcory
desc: The recently renovated ibis Styles Abidjan Marcory hotel has 135 air-conditioned rooms equipped with WIFI, offering a unique experience combining comfort and conviviality. Enjoy relaxing moments in its bar with terrace, its outdoor swimming pool and its restaurant offering tasty international cuisine and a varied buffet breakfast. The hotel also has a free outdoor car park and WOJO co-working spaces.
address: Bld Valéry Giscard d'Estaing, Marcory, BP 594

name: Novotel Abidjan Marcory
desc: Novotel Abidjan Marcory is a 5-star hotel in Marcory, close to the Plateau and airport. Our 201 rooms, including 10 suites, offer contemporary comfort. Enjoy amazing views of Ébrié Lagoon from LIVA restaurant on the 11th floor. Unwind at L'Escale cigar lounge, the Lobby Bar and Liva Pool Lounge Bar. A top choice for business travelers with 5 modern meeting rooms. Families will also love our kids' club.
address: Bd Valery Giscard d'Estaing, Bd Valery Giscard d'Estaing, Bd Valery Giscard d'Estaing
